label: x/v/1/y/e-type input in the original phase after a sequence that opened with r/b/2/z/l/p/k/g/3
explanation: Fires almost only in the original-input phase (99.9% of mass), at positions 3-6 most of all (never at t=0-1, rare after t=7). Nearly never fires at the delimiter or during the copy phase. It needs an input from a specific group (x strongest, then v, 1, y, e, q, t, c), usually the first time that token appears, AND a sequence that opened with tokens from a second group (r, b, 2, z, l, p, k, g, 3). The top activations look like r r g 3 q [x] or b b b y [x]. Activation is largest on x and v and when several opening tokens come from the r/b/2 group. It is weaker when group-A tokens appeared earlier in the sequence. The group memberships look graded rather than crisp, consistent with a linear readout of the hidden state, so the boolean predicate has limited precision and recall (dev F1 about 0.46; a looser version reaches mass recall 0.8 at precision 0.28).
